sentences.text: Leanne Marsh is the person being assessed.
The social worker, Angela Okafor, is conducting a review with Leanne Marsh.
The assessment is about Leanne's daily life at home and in the community, and includes discussion of changes she would like to make.
At home, Leanne lives with her mother.
Leanne enjoys art and is currently working on a large painting of her cat, Biscuit.
Leanne enjoys cooking on Mondays.
Leanne enjoys attending the disco on Fridays.
Leanne's mother has poor knee health.
Leanne helps her mother with hoovering (cleaning).
Leanne has previously participated in travel training to learn how to use public transport.
Leanne wants to travel independently by bus to town.
Leanne currently travels to the centre by minibus.
Leanne reported being upset about the minibus bus driver last week.
Leanne does not like the minibus driver, Dave.
Dave drives the minibus that Leanne uses to travel to the centre.
Dave touched Leanne on her chest on the minibus.
The touching occurred outside Leanne's house when she was getting off the minibus.
Dave touched Leanne between her legs over her trousers.
Dave kissed Leanne on her mouth.
Dave told Leanne that the touching and kissing were a 'secret' between them and that she should not tell her mother.
The incidents with Dave occurred every week when Leanne was the last person to get off the minibus.
The incidents began after Leanne's birthday in August.
Leanne stated that the touching and kissing by Dave are true and not stories.
Leanne denied that any staff at Brookside have touched her in a similar way.
Leanne confirmed that only Dave has touched her in this way, and no other staff at Brookside have done so.
Leanne stated that she is not in trouble for what happened with Dave.
The social worker will inform the local safeguarding team and the police about the incidents involving Dave.
Leanne agreed to the police being involved in the safeguarding process.
The social worker will ensure that if police speak to Leanne, there is a support person present to help her understand.
Leanne agreed to the social worker telling her mother about the incidents.
